definitions.explanation: Raw materials used in cooking; food items before they are prepared into a dish.

examples.japanese: {新鮮|しんせん}な{食材|しょくざい}を{使|つか}う。
{旬|しゅん}の{食材|しょくざい}は{美味|おい}しい。
examples.notes: 旬 refers to the peak season for food

examples.japanese: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}にある{食材|しょくざい}で{何|なに}か{作|つく}ろう。
examples.english: Let's make something with the ingredients in the fridge.

notes:
A general term for cooking ingredients. Related terms:
- {材料|ざいりょう} - materials/ingredients (broader, also non-food)
- {具|ぐ}/{具材|ぐざい} - ingredients/toppings (in dishes like ramen, soup)
- {原材料|げんざいりょう} - raw materials (on food labels)

Common collocations:
- {食材|しょくざい}を{買|か}う (buy ingredients)
- {食材|しょくざい}を{揃|そろ}える (gather ingredients)
- {地元|じもと}の{食材|しょくざい} (local ingredients)
- {高級|こうきゅう}{食材|しょくざい} (premium ingredients)
